schools.name: Heritage Model School
schools.about:
Nestled on a 1.5 Acre lush green expanse, Heritage Model School, Gopal Nagar is the first English Medium co-ed school in Bangaon that is based on well researched curriculum.
Heritage Model School is overseen by an excellent and dedicated team that has combined vision, energy, and focus which provides the perfect environment for the holistic growth of the children. It is equipped with state of- the-art facilities that foster overall development of the child into a global citizen of tomorrow.
schools.admissionNote:
Child safety is of utmost priority and Heritage Model School is the first ever school in India to have scan access to the kids and their parents in the school premises and buses. All entry and exit gates are manned and monitored to prevent any unauthorized access.
 1. Security Personnel
 2. Fire Hydrant
 3. Smoke Detector
 4. CCTV
